curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When life takes an unforeseen turn, how much can Travis and Gabby's sudden connection truly endure?
curatedMovie.description: In a quiet coastal town, neighbors Travis and Gabby fall into an unexpected romance that is soon tested by life-altering decisions.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: An emotional, medium-paced romantic drama with heavy personal stakes, ideal for an engaged date-night watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Ross Katz delivers an emotionally heavy romantic drama tailored for date night, balancing seaside warmth with heartfelt stakes.
